note: Fair-play only: no cheats, X-ray, auto-clickers or reach mods. Slugs were checked on Modrinth; the release matching your Minecraft version is picked at install time.

presets.title: PvP HUD Pack
presets.description: Right Shift HUD, fullbright, auto sprint, motion blur

presets.title: Skins
presets.description: See your offline skin and cape in game

mods.title: HUD+
mods.description: Press Right Shift in game: FPS, ping, CPS, coordinates, direction, biome, clock, armor status, potion effects, keystrokes, crosshair. Drag to place.

mods.title: True Fullbright
mods.description: Night-vision style full brightness with a toggle key.

mods.title: Auto Sprint
mods.description: Always sprinting without holding the key (ToggleSprint).

mods.title: Motion Blur
mods.description: Lunar-style motion blur. Uses the build that matches your Minecraft version.

mods.title: ModuloGUI
mods.description: All-in-one alternative: HUD, keystrokes, zoom, fullbright, waypoints, minimap. Opens with O. Use instead of HUD+, not with it.

mods.title: Simple HUD Enhanced
mods.description: Extra info HUD: TPS, light level, speed, biome, paper doll.

mods.title: CustomSkinLoader
mods.description: Shows your offline skin and cape in game.
